# ML anomaly detectors on Sherlock telemetry (physics features)

Unsupervised (train has no attacks). Features: per-element physics residuals (reported minus recomputed bus voltages, line P, transformer P, as in WP1-a) and first differences of the telemetry (no absolute operating-point values) (114 features). Isolation Forest (200 trees) and an MLP autoencoder (64-12-64), fit on the first 75 % of train. Threshold = 99.95th percentile of scores on the last 25 % of train (never seen in fitting); alarm when the score stays above it for L records, L = ceil(1.5 x longest calibration run), at least 3. D1 is the physics-residual detector of WP1-a (on 02-Semiurban the column D1 holds the state-estimation bad-data detector, SE-BDD). Wall time 66 s.
